title: Accessibility snapshot contract v1 — FROZEN at M1
description: What ScreenReaderService produces and the planner/step engine consume. One snapshot of the current screen: a flat indexed list of elements, own-package filtered. FROZEN interface between the accessibility layer and everything above it.

package_name.description: Foreground app package at snapshot time.

settled.description: True when the screen has stopped mutating (debounced idle). The step engine waits for this before resolving a highlight, so the pointer never lands mid-transition.

resource_id.description: Bare view id without package prefix, e.g. amount_field. Empty string if the node has none.

bounds.description: Screen-pixel bounds. The overlay draws the highlight here directly.
